title: Python Stopwatch in 30 Seconds

steps.title: Step 1: Create the Stopwatch Class
steps.explanation: We start by importing the time module and defining a Stopwatch class with start and elapsed time attributes.

steps.title: Step 2: Add Start and Stop Methods
steps.explanation: We add start and stop methods to track time and calculate the elapsed time when stopping.

steps.title: Step 3: Use the Stopwatch
steps.explanation: Now we create an instance, start it, pause for 2 seconds, stop it, and print the elapsed time.

steps.title: Step 4: See It in Action
steps.explanation: The code runs and shows the time it took — just like a real stopwatch!

steps.title: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Try modifying the sleep time or adding more features — the possibilities are endless!

intro_hook: Ever wanted to time how long your code runs? Let's build a stopwatch!
